topic: New Holiday Resorts in the UK

transcript.speaker: Audrey
transcript.text: Good afternoon and thanks for listening to Holiday Talk. Our guest today is travel journalist and reviewer Simon Beattie.

transcript.speaker: Audrey
transcript.text: He will be discussing some of the new vacation resorts that will be opening this year in the UK as many holiday makers are looking to travel locally rather than heading to other destinations that cost more money.

transcript.speaker: Audrey
transcript.text: Thanks for joining us this afternoon Simon.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: And thank you for inviting me Audrey.

transcript.speaker: Audrey
transcript.text: So I understand that there are several new holiday resorts that will be launching for the upcoming vacation season.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Yes there are quite a few new establishments opening up. First we have the Blue Sands Resort opening in Brighton. It's a great place for young kids as there are lots of activities for them to do. It even has a small amusement park. So if you prefer not being around children it's probably not the best place for you. It opens in April.
transcript.highlight_text: It's a great place for young kids as there are lots of activities for them to do.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Also opening that month is Shores Resort near Bournemouth. This facility has a lot of nightlife and entertainment so it is more geared to adult tourists. Kids are welcome but it doesn't sound like there is much for them to do there.
transcript.highlight_text: it is more geared to adult tourists. Kids are welcome but it doesn't sound like there is much for them to do there.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Now the Peeland Hotel and Resorts has just opened to the public. It's got a massive water park and lots of fun activities just for children. However the resorts have specific areas reserved for adults only as well so there's something for everyone.
transcript.highlight_text: the resorts have specific areas reserved for adults only as well so there's something for everyone.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: And there are lots of other amusement parks and outdoor activities in the area too.

transcript.speaker: Audrey
transcript.text: There are including water sports, hiking trails and beaches and then we move on to the Zone Fun Beach Resort in Selcombe.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Now that facility is geared to university age travellers. It's got a nightclub, an outdoor stage and even a floating dance floor so it isn't particularly recommended for families and it will be launching in May.

transcript.text: So there are a lot of new options out there. Now could you tell us a bit about costs?
